implementation_summary: resolveAuditAi(deps: {setup, keys: Pick<KeyResolver,'resolveKey'>, models?, budget?, createProvider?}) returns {ok:false, reason:'no-ai-key'} with no provider created when no key (or an empty key); otherwise it builds the provider once with (key.provider, key.apiKey) and returns AuditAi.ask(stage, messages, options). ask() stops at once on an already-aborted signal, returns {ok:false, reason:'budget-spent'} with no request when the AuditAiRequestBudget is spent, sends model=modelForStage(stage, models, defaults) (undefined when null), stage, signal and timeoutMs, and returns {ok:true, completion, model, claimWords}. Saved model ids are not sent when the key belongs to a provider other than the saved one. auditAiRequestBudget(n) is an in-memory counter. AuditAiModelsStore(stateDir) reads and writes audit-ai-models.json ({schemaVersion:1, models}) with writeJsonAtomic after validateAuditAiModelsUpdate; refused bodies change nothing and return the validator's errors; null resets a stage; saves are serialized; reading keeps only valid entries for known stages and treats a corrupt file as empty. claim-words.ts re-exports findClaimWords and the word lists from documents/wording.ts (one list) and adds hasClaimWords.

risks: The claim-word list is the full ADR 0018 list from documents/wording.ts (also compliance, safe, hack-proof, Not ready yet, release verdict, release-ready), wider than the five words plus 'ready to release' in the task text; a reviewer should confirm this is wanted for AI output.
Derived forms (securely, insecure, non-compliant, noncompliant) are deliberately not flagged.
ask() reports claimWords but does not reject the answer; each caller must refuse to show an answer that has any.
The new modules are not re-exported from packages/core/src/index.ts (not in this task's ownership); callers import them by path.
RISK-005 is only mitigated once providers honour options.signal/timeoutMs; this module only passes them on.
The budget counts a request when it is sent, even if the provider then fails.
A file with a newer schemaVersion is still read, and a save rewrites it as version 1.
